messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on the nearest weekday when it falls on a weekend), giving you a three‑day break that includes a Saturday and/or Sunday.

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------------------------------------|---------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 (Thu)** | New Year’s Day | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Jan 2 (Fri)** | New Year’s Day (observed) | All provinces & territories | **Yes** | Observed on Monday because Jan 1 was Sunday. Gives a 3‑day weekend Jan 1‑3. |
| **Feb 20 (Thu)** | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Mar 10 (Thu)** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories | **No** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday, but it’s only one day. |
| **May 22 (Thu)** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Jul 1 (Thu)** | Canada Day | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Sep 4 (Thu)** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Oct 9 (Thu)** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Nov 11 (Thu)** | Remembrance Day | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Dec 25 (Thu)** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | **No** | Falls on Thursday – no extended weekend. |
| **Dec 26 (Fri)** | Boxing Day | All provinces & territories | **Yes** | Boxing Day is a statutory holiday on Friday, giving a 3‑day weekend Dec 24‑26. |

### Summary of 2023 long weekends in Canada

| Long‑Weekend | Dates | Holiday(s) | Provinces/Territories |
|--------------|-------|------------|-----------------------|
| **New Year’s** | Jan 1 – 3 | New Year’s Day (observed) | All |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 24 – 26 | Boxing Day | All |

> **Note:**  
> - Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., **Family Day** in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba; **St. Patrick’s Day** in Newfoundland & Labrador; **St. George’s Day** in Prince Edward Island).  
> - If you’re planning trips in those provinces, you’ll want to add those dates to your personal list.  
> - The table above lists only the nationwide statutory holidays that produce a 3‑day break in 2023.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends or a different definition of “long weekend,” let me know!
